_meta.note: Canonical video script. Each line is spoken by Kokoro af_heart and shown as a caption; 'take' names a scripted Playwright take in scripts/video/takes.py (card:<id> = a still from scripts/video/cards.html). Build: scripts/video/make-draft.sh <out_dir>.
_meta.rules: No greeting; the voice never claims to be a person. No statistic unless verified against a primary source and cited on screen (the hook uses none). No credentials or personal data on screen. Specific names in lines must match the filmed live run (takes.py prints them).
_meta.endcard: Credit is on-screen text only. Replace DEMO_URL / REPO_URL in scripts/video/cards.html after the user approves hosting and a public repo.

lines: Every tour is a bet.
Book the wrong room in the wrong city, and the empty seats are yours to pay for.
Big acts have data teams. Small acts route by guesswork.
Tour Scout plans the tour from where the fans actually are.
Type an act, confirm it's the right one on Qloo, and choose the stops.
Then it scouts live. Each Qloo call lands as a numbered source.
Qloo's fan map finds where this audience concentrates across the country.
Each hotspot is snapped to a touring city, and every city is scored by how strongly these fans favour its live rooms.
For Big Thief, that's a tight New England run.
Each stop shows the neighbourhood where fans cluster, real rooms they favour, and an opener whose audience shares their taste.
Claude Haiku drafts a pitch for each booker.
Every line cites Qloo evidence, and a guard withholds what the data can't support, like turnout promises or invented room sizes.
Ask the scout a question.
An agent picks Qloo tools, runs them, and proposes a change.
The server checks every proposal against what the scout actually found. Nothing changes until you apply it.
Every number links to its Qloo request. Tap a Q-number to see exactly what was asked.
No credentials and no personal data. Only aggregate taste.
It works for stand-up comedians too, with comedy clubs and club comics as openers.
And for new acts, planned from the fans of artists they sound like.
Under the hood: Qloo's where-popular, recommend, compare-audiences and tag workflows, through the official Qloo harness.
Tour Scout. Find your fans before you book the room.
Thanks for watching.
